meanings.en: to be absent or not able to be found
meanings.exampleEn: Two pages seem to be missing from this report.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu rapordan iki sayfa eksik gibi görünüyor.

meanings.en: to be good at finding ways to deal with problems
meanings.exampleEn: You have to be resourceful to survive with so little money.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu kadar az parayla hayatta kalmak için becerikli olman gerekir.

meanings.en: to be certain about something
meanings.exampleEn: I'm not sure that this is the right address.
meanings.exampleTr: Bunun doğru adres olduğundan emin değilim.

meanings.en: to fail to recognise or be grateful for something
meanings.exampleEn: He was completely unappreciative of all the help she gave him.
meanings.exampleTr: Ona verdiği tüm yardımın değerini hiç bilmiyordu.

meanings.en: to not be sure or confident about something
meanings.exampleEn: She was uncertain about what to do next.
meanings.exampleTr: Bundan sonra ne yapacağı konusunda kararsızdı.

meanings.tr: hayal gücünden yoksun olmak, sıradan olmak
meanings.en: to lack new or interesting ideas; to be dull
meanings.exampleEn: The design was safe but rather unimaginative.
meanings.exampleTr: Tasarım güvenliydi ama oldukça yaratıcılıktan yoksundu.

meanings.en: to not be certain about something
meanings.exampleEn: I'm unsure whether I should accept the job offer.
meanings.exampleTr: İş teklifini kabul etmeli miyim, emin değilim.

meanings.en: for the reason that
meanings.exampleEn: We stayed at home because it was raining.
meanings.exampleTr: Yağmur yağdığı için evde kaldık.

meanings.en: as a result of; due to
meanings.exampleEn: The flight was delayed because of the bad weather.
meanings.exampleTr: Uçuş kötü hava nedeniyle ertelendi.

meanings.en: a boy or man employed by a hotel to carry guests' luggage
meanings.exampleEn: The bellboy carried our suitcases up to the room.
meanings.exampleTr: Otel komisi valizlerimizi odaya kadar taşıdı.

meanings.en: aggressive or hostile behaviour
meanings.exampleEn: His belligerence made it impossible to have a calm discussion.
meanings.exampleTr: Saldırganlığı sakin bir tartışma yapmayı imkânsız kılıyordu.

meanings.en: below the surface of the earth
meanings.exampleEn: Many of the plant's roots grow deep belowground.
meanings.exampleTr: Bitkinin köklerinin çoğu yerin derinliklerinde büyür.

meanings.en: next to or at the side of someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: Come and sit beside me.
meanings.exampleTr: Gel ve yanıma otur.

meanings.en: most popular or most favoured
meanings.exampleEn: She is one of the best-liked teachers in the school.
meanings.exampleTr: O, okuldaki en sevilen öğretmenlerden biridir.

meanings.en: in or into the space separating two things or people
meanings.exampleEn: The shop is between the bank and the post office.
meanings.exampleTr: Dükkân banka ile postane arasında.

meanings.en: in the period separating two times or events
meanings.exampleEn: I'll call you between two and three o'clock.
meanings.exampleTr: Seni saat iki ile üç arasında ararım.

meanings.en: on or to the further side of something
meanings.exampleEn: The mountains lie beyond the river.
meanings.exampleTr: Dağlar nehrin ötesinde uzanıyor.

meanings.en: more than or outside the limits of something
meanings.exampleEn: The damage was beyond repair.
meanings.exampleTr: Hasar tamir edilemeyecek kadar büyüktü.

meanings.en: a flat piece of wood or other hard material used for a purpose
meanings.exampleEn: He wrote the answer on the board.
meanings.exampleTr: Cevabı tahtaya yazdı.

meanings.en: a group of people who manage or direct a company or organisation
meanings.exampleEn: The board voted to approve the merger.
meanings.exampleTr: Yönetim kurulu birleşmeyi onaylamak için oy kullandı.

meanings.en: a member of a gang that robs people, especially travellers
meanings.exampleEn: The travellers were attacked by brigands in the mountains.
meanings.exampleTr: Yolcular dağlarda haydutlar tarafından saldırıya uğradı.

meanings.en: the amount by which a government's spending is greater than its income
meanings.exampleEn: The government is struggling to reduce the budget deficit.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet bütçe açığını azaltmaya çalışıyor.

meanings.en: a narrow bed, especially one fixed to a wall or in a stack
meanings.exampleEn: The children slept in bunks in the summer camp.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar yaz kampında ranzalarda uyudu.

meanings.en: nonsense; something untrue or foolish (informal)
meanings.exampleEn: Don't believe him, it's all bunk.
meanings.exampleTr: Ona inanma, hepsi saçmalık.

meanings.en: to enter a room or place suddenly and noisily
meanings.exampleEn: She burst in without knocking and started shouting.
meanings.exampleTr: Kapıyı çalmadan içeri daldı ve bağırmaya başladı.

meanings.en: near or beside something
meanings.exampleEn: She was sitting by the window.
meanings.exampleTr: Pencerenin yanında oturuyordu.

meanings.en: used to show who or what does something, or the means used
meanings.exampleEn: The novel was written by a famous author.
meanings.exampleTr: Roman ünlü bir yazar tarafından yazıldı.

meanings.en: using a machine rather than by hand
meanings.exampleEn: These carpets are made by machine, not by hand.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu halılar elle değil, makineyle yapılıyor.

meanings.en: through the mouth, especially of taking medicine
meanings.exampleEn: The medicine should be taken by mouth twice a day.
meanings.exampleTr: İlaç günde iki kez ağızdan alınmalıdır.

meanings.en: according to what is just, correct, or legally allowed
meanings.exampleEn: The property belongs to her by right.
meanings.exampleTr: Mülk hakkı gereği ona aittir.

meanings.en: a road that goes around a town rather than through it
meanings.exampleEn: We took the bypass to avoid the city centre traffic.
meanings.exampleTr: Şehir merkezi trafiğinden kaçınmak için çevre yolunu kullandık.

meanings.tr: atlamak, es geçmek, devre dışı bırakmak
meanings.en: to avoid something by going around it
meanings.exampleEn: The new system lets you bypass the usual approval process.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni sistem, olağan onay sürecini atlamanı sağlıyor.

meanings.en: the staff on an aircraft who look after passengers
meanings.exampleEn: The cabin crew served drinks shortly after take-off.
meanings.exampleTr: Kabin ekibi kalkıştan kısa süre sonra içecek servisi yaptı.

meanings.tr: tatlı dille kandırma, ikna etme, dil dökme
meanings.en: the act of persuading someone by flattery or gentle pressure
meanings.exampleEn: After a lot of cajoling, she agreed to sing for us.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir sürü dil döktükten sonra bizim için şarkı söylemeyi kabul etti.

meanings.en: a large gourd, or a container made from its dried shell
meanings.exampleEn: She poured the water from a calabash into the bowl.
meanings.exampleTr: Suyu bir su kabağından kâseye döktü.

meanings.en: a drug or agent that has a soothing or sedative effect
meanings.exampleEn: The doctor prescribed a mild calmative to help him sleep.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktor uyumasına yardımcı olması için hafif bir yatıştırıcı reçete etti.

meanings.en: a feeling of friendship and trust among people who work or spend time together
meanings.exampleEn: There was a strong sense of camaraderie among the team members.
meanings.exampleTr: Takım üyeleri arasında güçlü bir arkadaşlık ruhu vardı.

meanings.en: a person who takes part in organised efforts to achieve social or political change
meanings.exampleEn: She is a well-known campaigner for human rights.
meanings.exampleTr: O, insan hakları için tanınmış bir aktivisttir.

meanings.en: a person who stays in a tent or camp for a holiday
meanings.exampleEn: The campers pitched their tents by the lake.
meanings.exampleTr: Kampçılar çadırlarını gölün kenarına kurdu.

meanings.en: a vehicle equipped for people to live and sleep in while travelling
meanings.exampleEn: They travelled around the country in a camper.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülkeyi bir karavanla dolaştılar.

meanings.en: a decision to stop or end something that was planned
meanings.exampleEn: The cancellation of the flight left us stranded at the airport.
meanings.exampleTr: Uçuşun iptali bizi havaalanında mahsur bıraktı.

meanings.en: the quality of being open and honest in speech
meanings.exampleEn: She spoke about her mistakes with surprising candor.
meanings.exampleTr: Hatalarından şaşırtıcı bir açık sözlülükle bahsetti.

meanings.en: a round or cylindrical container for holding a substance
meanings.exampleEn: She kept the flour in a metal canister.
meanings.exampleTr: Unu metal bir kutuda saklıyordu.

meanings.en: a cover fixed above something to provide shade or shelter
meanings.exampleEn: We sat under the canopy to escape the sun.
meanings.exampleTr: Güneşten kaçmak için gölgeliğin altına oturduk.

meanings.en: the uppermost layer of branches and leaves in a forest
meanings.exampleEn: Sunlight barely reached the forest floor through the thick canopy.
meanings.exampleTr: Işık, yoğun ağaç örtüsünden orman zeminine güçlükle ulaşıyordu.

meanings.tr: eşkin (atın tırıs ile dörtnala arası koşuşu)
meanings.en: a horse's pace between a trot and a gallop
meanings.exampleEn: The horse broke into a gentle canter across the field.
meanings.exampleTr: At, tarlada yumuşak bir eşkine geçti.

meanings.en: to use a situation to your own advantage
meanings.exampleEn: The company capitalised on the growing demand for electric cars.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, elektrikli arabalara olan artan talepten yararlandı.

meanings.en: a sudden and unaccountable change of mood or behaviour
meanings.exampleEn: His decisions seemed to depend on the caprice of the moment.
meanings.exampleTr: Kararları o anki hevesine bağlı gibiydi.

meanings.en: given to sudden and unpredictable changes of mood or behaviour
meanings.exampleEn: The weather here can be very capricious in spring.
meanings.exampleTr: Buradaki hava ilkbaharda çok değişken olabilir.

meanings.tr: araba barınağı, üstü kapalı araç yeri
meanings.en: a covered structure that protects a car from the weather
meanings.exampleEn: They built a simple car shelter beside the house.
meanings.exampleTr: Evin yanına basit bir araba barınağı yaptılar.

meanings.en: a person who looks after a sick, elderly, or disabled person
meanings.exampleEn: She works as a carer for elderly people in their homes.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaşlı insanlara evlerinde bakıcı olarak çalışıyor.

meanings.en: a gentle or loving touch
meanings.exampleEn: She felt the soft caress of the breeze on her face.
meanings.exampleTr: Meltemin yüzündeki yumuşak okşayışını hissetti.

meanings.en: to touch someone or something gently and lovingly
meanings.exampleEn: He gently caressed the baby's cheek.
meanings.exampleTr: Bebeğin yanağını nazikçe okşadı.

meanings.en: performed or completed (a task, order, or plan)
meanings.exampleEn: The experiment was carried out under strict conditions.
meanings.exampleTr: Deney sıkı koşullar altında gerçekleştirildi.
